Develop bunker utilisation plans and monitor bunker consumption to reduce associated costs
Plan voyages to optimise speed and cost reduction
Calculate and process payables for demurrage, third-party claims, etc. and receivables, in accordance to charter party requirements
Arrange class, ship inspection report programme (SIRE) and other relevant surveys and maintain vessel operational status through tracking of daily reports, class documents and certificates
Coordinate the day-to-day operational activities and liaise with charterers, brokers and/or masters to ensure safe and efficient voyage operation
Resolve claims and payment disputes arising from voyage operations
Update clients on vessel arrivals, crew changes, bunker consumption and other relevant vessel operation matters
Maintain and update fleet operational record systems and customer databases
